name: Microsoft Copilot
summary: Consumer Copilot chat at copilot.microsoft.com for web search, image creation, and everyday questions—not the same product page as Microsoft 365 Copilot for work.
description: Microsoft Copilot on the web is the free-to-try assistant at copilot.microsoft.com. It answers questions, generates images, and helps with writing using Microsoft's latest models. Microsoft 365 Copilot is the paid work assistant embedded in Word, Excel, and Teams; this fiche covers the consumer web experience only.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free tier on copilot.microsoft.com; Copilot Pro and Microsoft 365 Copilot are separate paid offers.

features: Web-grounded answers with citations from Bing search.
Image generation and editing in the Copilot chat.
Voice and file upload on supported browsers.
Sign-in with a personal Microsoft account for history sync.

howToUse.title: Open the consumer Copilot site
howToUse.description: Go to copilot.microsoft.com in a browser—not the Microsoft 365 marketing hub.

howToUse.title: Sign in or continue as guest
howToUse.description: Use a Microsoft account to save chats or try features without signing in where allowed.

howToUse.title: Choose a mode
howToUse.description: Pick chat, image creation, or deep research when offered, then refine with follow-up prompts.

howToUse.title: Compare with work Copilot
howToUse.description: For Office-embedded Copilot inside your tenant, use the Microsoft 365 Copilot fiche instead.
